title: The life of Jesus in the Gospels
note: The four Gospels tell of Jesus' birth, his baptism by John, his teaching and healing in Galilee with twelve chosen disciples, and his final days in Jerusalem. Matthew and Luke include birth stories; Mark begins with John the Baptist; John begins with the eternal Word made flesh.
